documents.text: Scott Murray (footballer, born 1988) Scott Murray (born 3 March 1988 in Glasgow) is a Scottish former footballer. Murray won the Scottish Youth Cup with Kilmarnock in 2004 before being released shortly after. Dundee manager Jim Duffy then signed Murray on a 2-year contract. He made his first team debut against Airdrie in the Scottish Challenge Cup saving two penalties in the penalty shoot-out at the end of the game to send Dundee through to the next round. He went on to make 25 league and cup appearances for the Dens Park side in the 2005–06 season, winning Young Player
